what: The Job Application Tracker keeps all your job applications in one place: company, job title, link, date applied, status, next step and its date, contact, salary and notes.
See them on a board with a column for each status (Saved, Applied, Interview, Offer, Rejected, No reply) and drag cards between columns, or as a list you can sort and filter.

A reminders view shows upcoming and overdue next steps and applications with no news for two weeks, and the stats view shows your response and interview rates. Everything stays in your browser, with CSV and JSON export, import and print.
uses: Never lose track of where you applied.
See your interviews and follow-ups in date order.
Spot applications with no reply after two weeks.
Keep salary ranges in any currency side by side.
Share a printed or CSV list with a coach or adviser.
tutorial: Type the company and job title, pick a status and the date you applied, then press Add application.
Optionally add the job link, a contact, a salary range with currency, and notes.
Type what is next (for example "Phone interview") and its date.
On the board, drag a card by its handle to another column, or use the Move to menu.
Open Reminders to see overdue and upcoming steps. Press Done when a step is finished.
Open Stats for counts per status and your response rate.
Export JSON or CSV now and then, and Import to restore or move to another device.
features: Six status columns with drag and drop that works with touch.
Sort by date, next step, company, status or salary, and filter.
Overdue, today, next 7 days and no-news-for-2-weeks lists.
Response rate, interview rate, offers and applications per week and month.
Salary ranges in your chosen currency, per year, month, week, day or hour.
JSON backup and CSV for Excel or Google Sheets.
Saved only in this browser. Nothing is uploaded.

example.title: Worked example: six applications
example.text: Lee tracks six jobs: one saved, three applied, one interview and one offer. The interview card has "Phone interview" set for tomorrow, so Reminders shows it under Next 7 days. One application sent 20 days ago with no next step appears under "No news for 2+ weeks". Stats shows 5 applications sent, a 40% response rate (interview, offer and rejections) and a 40% interview rate.

tips: Add the job the same day you apply, while you still have the link.
Set a follow-up date about 7 to 10 days after applying.
Paste the job advert into the notes: adverts often disappear later.
Write who you spoke to and what they asked after each interview.
Export a backup every week or two.
problems: They are stored per browser and device. Private windows and clearing site data remove them. Import your last export to restore them.
Drag and drop does not work on my phone
Hold the ⠿ handle at the top right of a card to drag, or use the Move to menu.
The first row needs column names, including Company or Job title. Files exported from this tool always work.
Pick the currency next to the salary. Your last choice is remembered for new applications.
